thread_title: tub of rugelii's (old photos from long ago)
breadcrumb: tub of rugelii's (old photos from long ago)

posts.body_html:
Here are some pictures that I dug up from waaaaaaaaay back in 2003...that actually wasn't too long ago, but seems like it. Anyways, hope you enjoy these tubs of seed grown rugelii's that I got from the ICPS meeting in 1997 held in Atlanta Georgia:





View from above-these plants were very lemon yellow:



These were the extra divisions that I was able to squeeze out of the tub above. Notice the very yellow alatas in the photo-those are the the fat-headed ones from the San Rayburn Reservoir, TX:



A view of some S. flava var. rugelii lids:
